usage: 哥哥 is a noun meaning 'older brother' and refers to a male sibling who is older than the speaker.
You can use 哥哥 to talk about your own older brother or when addressing or referring to someone else's older brother.
In a sentence, 哥哥 usually comes before verbs or other nouns, acting as the subject or object.
It can also be used with possessive particles like 我 (my) or 你 (your) to specify whose older brother is being talked about.
When speaking casually, 哥哥 can also be a friendly way to address an unfamiliar older male around your age.
